remarks: Newly refreshed 1 bedroom unit. It is light- filled and move-in ready. Open concept which features Kitchen with wide granite counter (for eating area), combined with the comfortable living room. The primary bedroom is spacious and offers 2 closets (1 walk-in). Convenience of in-unit washer and dryer. This young mid-rise Complex includes Fitness Room and lobby/mail room for private deliveries. Unit offers C/A and Reserved parking. Close to all of Norwalk has to offer from the Restaurants, Library, Spectacular SoNo Collection Mall, Beaches and more. Easy access to Highway. Tenant responsible for all utilities: credit report, liability insurance, heat, hot water and electricity. Excellent job history and credit score is a must
